source_snapshot.items: Firmware upgrade should fail for corruption, signature and rollback checks on ERoT/Aps; old firmware intact.
source_snapshot.procedure: Flash unsigned image, check version, AC cycle, recheck.
source_snapshot.criteria: All three rejection mechanisms; old version and normal boot retained.

old_problem: Corruption, bad signature and anti-rollback across ERoT/Aps are required, but Procedure provides only one unsigned attempt.
disposition_reason: The three negative mechanisms are identifiable and can be preserved as separate authorized attempts. ED-03 permits vendor negative artifacts/codes as runtime inputs; no mechanism may cross-credit another.
decision_basis: Separated corruption, signature and rollback for each applicable component.
No invalid image, flash or AC cycle occurred.

test_case.purpose: Verify separately that corrupted, bad-signature and rollback-disallowed images are rejected while active firmware remains intact.
required_package: Expected rejection stage/code/policy counter per mechanism
Stable power, AC authorization and recovery
test_case.test_command: For one component and one approved negative artifact at a time, capture baseline, submit the update, preserve rejection task/code, prove active version unchanged; only after safe rejection authorize AC cycle and normal-boot/version recheck.
test_case.expected_result: Every required mechanism is rejected at its signed stage/code; active firmware stays unchanged before and after AC and SUT boots healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Unsigned rejection cannot prove corruption or anti-rollback; each component/mechanism needs its own evidence.
test_case.recovery: If any invalid image is accepted or state changes, do not AC-cycle; invoke vendor recovery/OOB procedure.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure is explicitly expanded into the three source-required independent mechanisms without cross-credit.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind components, vendor negative artifacts, rejection codes/counters and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; RUNTIME AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED

project_authority: Negative artifacts and rejection codes are vendor/project-specific.
